entries.105bd285da17f45a: As growth strategies, it cites four points: expanding a stable recurring revenue base in the Internet Infrastructure Business, creating synergies between the Internet Infrastructure Business and the Internet Advertising and Media Business, creating new businesses such as GMO GPU Cloud, and expanding scale through acquisitions and joint ventures.
entries.155f9a6412f0fff3: Provides infrastructure services and advertising and media services
entries.203de691f531f8b1: The reportable segments are three: the Internet Infrastructure Business, the Internet Advertising and Media Business and other. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥65,864 million for the Internet Infrastructure Business, ¥12,490 million for the Internet Advertising and Media Business and ¥193 million for other. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of the total, and no external customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue in the fiscal year ended December 2025. In the previous consolidated fiscal year, the major customers were LINE Yahoo Corporation at ¥2,227 million and Epos Card Co., Ltd. at ¥1,404 million.
entries.218a3551c4988ba0: In the Internet Infrastructure Business, existing services such as domains, rental servers and internet access performed steadily, supported by the recurring-billing business model.
